frontmatter.name: standards
frontmatter.description: Core working standards for every session and project across any agent harness or model: use caveman for lower read/write token usage, use graphify to find and explore the codebase before raw search, ask all grilling questions (grilling, grill-me, grill-with-docs) through the harness's structured question tool, use ponytail before writing code, use caveman-commit and logical non-AI-attributed commits when committing, and maintain CHANGELOG.md with Keep a Changelog 1.1.0. Auto-install any missing require

frontmatter.name: svelte-standards
frontmatter.description: Frontend working standards for Svelte 5 apps across any agent harness or model. Extends the core standards skill with required Svelte sv add-ons (ai-tools, eslint, mdsvex, paraglide, playwright, prettier, tailwindcss, vitest), interactive npx shadcn-svelte@latest init via the harness's question tool, Vazirmatn font for Persian (fa), UI component rules (shadcn-svelte and shadcn-svelte-extras only), unified frontend design skills (frontend-design, web-design-guidelines, ui-taste, ios-design across all vi

frontmatter.name: sveltekit-standards
frontmatter.description: Full-stack and backend working standards for SvelteKit 3 apps across any agent harness or model. Extends svelte-standards and standards with backend sv add-ons (drizzle, better-auth, adapter-node, remoteFunctions), subpath imports (#lib/*, #db, #db/*, #services/*), composed hooks, one-file-per-table Drizzle schema, server-only better-auth flows, CASL permissions, and strict 6-layer architecture (Remote -> Service -> Query -> DB). Read before writing, editing, or reviewing any SvelteKit code.

frontmatter.name: setup-sveltekit
frontmatter.description: Scaffold a new SvelteKit 3 app on top of setup-project by relaying every interactive CLI prompt (sv create, sv add, drizzle-kit push, shadcn-svelte init) to the user through the harness's structured question tool, installing svelte-standards and sveltekit-standards, and applying minimal architecture wiring. Use when the user wants to start, create, bootstrap or scaffold a new SvelteKit project.

frontmatter.name: setup-tauri
frontmatter.description: Scaffold a new Tauri desktop/mobile app with SvelteKit (TypeScript, static SPA), setup-project (standards, Matt Pocock config, graphify), Svelte frontend sv add-ons (tailwindcss, ai-tools, eslint, mdsvex, paraglide, prettier, playwright, vitest), svelte-standards, and shadcn-svelte by relaying every interactive CLI prompt through the harness's structured question tool. Use when the user wants to start, create, bootstrap or scaffold a new Tauri app.

frontmatter.name: setup-project
frontmatter.description: Set up the agent tooling of any project folder (new or existing, any framework) with my base skill group (standards, find-skills, the Matt Pocock skills, caveman, caveman-commit, ponytail), the Matt Pocock skills config, graphify, AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md importing the standards skill, and a CHANGELOG.md. Works standalone and as the base step of framework setup skills such as setup-sveltekit and setup-tauri. Use when the user wants to set up, initialise or bootstrap agent tooling for a project.
